items.response:
Ugh, standing the whole way with a backpack in your face is a rough start to an office day. Hope the rest of it is calmer.
Action: still holding the 10:30 Sat 23 May tune-up for Leo's bike at Gears on Gerrard; tell me if you want me to book it.

Dropped calls before the weekend are not okay. I don't have your internet provider in front of me, so I'll confirm it from your billing emails first.
Action: identify your provider from your bills, check their outage page for your address, and open a support ticket noting the dropped calls this afternoon, then send you the ticket number.

Claro, rapido: completa con el o la. 1) ___ dia 2) ___ foto 3) ___ tema 4) ___ moto 5) ___ idioma 6) ___ mano 7) ___ mapa 8) ___ problema.
Action: wait for your answers, then correct them with a short rule for each exception and send a second round.

Here's what I can see so far: I drafted your out-of-office for Fri 22 May (back Mon 25 May, Aisha covers payouts), and pulled the beta retro RSVPs (9 yes, Olivia tentative, Jonah no reply, top Miro theme webhook retries).
Action: finish the calendar check for the 22nd and report back.

Quick ideas for Diego's partner: register on the City of Toronto Child Care Wait List for many centres, call directors every couple of months, and also ask about licensed home daycare through an agency, which often has openings sooner.
Action: turn this into a short text you can forward.

Good news. I'll let the kitchen crew know and find a time that works for them. I need the electrician's arrival time too, and I'll check how the crew prefers to be contacted before messaging.
Action: find the contractor's contact and contact preference, message them about Monday with the electrician's timing, and send you their answer.

Two tarts from the Dundas place is a perfectly reasonable amount, no regrets needed.
Action: nothing needed.

Two clean options: 'I tried to cut my budget, but my expenses said it was a hard no.' Or: 'I like my numbers like my meetings: balanced and over on time.' Both are safe for standup.
Action: set a reminder for Friday before the 9:45 standup with your pick, and send more if you want.

Jess should weigh:
- Carrying costs (mortgage, condo fees, property tax) against likely rent
- Tax: selling vs renting can change capital gains treatment, so get an accountant's view
- Landlord work: vacancies, repairs, tenant rules
- Her mortgage renewal date and rates
- Market outlook and what she'd do with the sale proceeds
- Her plans for the next two years
Action: send as a short list you can pass to Jess.

Saved in a private medical note:
- Penicillin allergy: hives
- Seasonal allergies in May, managed with Reactine
Action: create the note 'Medical info' and make sure the penicillin allergy comes up when I book appointments for you.

TL;DR: screens in the hour before bed delay sleep (about 19 minutes later in a 2025 study of kids 6 to 9), mostly from light, stimulation, and displacing wind-down routines. What helped: a fixed screens-off time an hour before bed, devices charged outside bedrooms, and reading instead. Timing mattered more than total screen time.
Action: none needed; I can set a screens-off reminder for Leo's bedtime if you want.

Rule of thumb: a retention curve has flattened when the period over period drop is near zero (for example under 1 to 2 percentage points) for three or more consecutive periods, at a level above zero. Check that cohorts are big enough that the flat part isn't just noise, and compare newer cohorts to older ones.
Action: apply this to your cohort chart if you send it.

Anytime. Heads up: none of the required forms are marked complete yet. Before day 1 you need the camper health form and the authorized pickup list, with photo consent optional. Drop-off is at the Winchester St gate, 8:45 to 9:15.
Action: add a to-do to finish the health form and pickup list before Mon 29 Jun.

On it. I'll unsubscribe from Old Navy, Wayfair, Uber Eats promos, Lululemon and the Dyson emails, and archive the existing promos from them. Old Navy needs a login, which is saved in Notes under Inbox cleanup, and I'll leave receipts and transactional senders alone.
Action: unsubscribe from the five senders, archive only their promo emails, keep Uber Eats receipts, and report back.

I don't have that 13 Dec conversation in front of me, and I don't want to guess at quantities. Scaling is simple though: triple every ingredient, and keep the bake time the same, just baking in batches.
Action: search the 2025-12-13 chat for the recipe, and if I can't find it ask you for the ingredient amounts from the bag, then send the tripled numbers.

Sending the reply to the school council now. For the car insurance, start getting quotes about 30 to 45 days before your term ends. In Ontario you can cancel any time, but switching at the end of the term avoids a short-rate fee, and there's no formal notice period once the new policy is bound.
Action: send the school council reply, and if you snap a photo of the letter I'll pull the term end date and set the reminder for quotes.

Sending the thank-you text to Hannah now. For dinner for five with no shellfish: roast chicken with lemon and herbs, roasted potatoes and green beans, a simple salad, and chocolate pots de creme. Mocktail for Grace: cranberry, lime and rosemary topped with ginger beer or sparkling water, served in a nice glass for the toast.
Action: send Hannah's text, then build the full NYE menu, timeline and shopping list if you like it.

On it. I'll find Purina Pro Plan Sensitive Skin & Stomach in salmon and make sure the listing is the right flavour and not a chicken-based variant before ordering.
Action: check your last order for the bag size, find the matching listing, verify the flavour and ingredients, then place the order and send you the confirmation.

I'll check the Withrow rink status and Saturday afternoon's forecast. One question: the swim lessons I have noted are on Tuesdays, so is Saturday a different swim?
Action: check the City rink status and hours for Saturday afternoon and the weather, then tell you if skating after swim works.

Reminder added for 17:15. I'll also fix your copy of the 1:1: Wednesdays 11:30 starting this January. Tom owns the event, so I'll accept his new series and remove your old Thursday copy.
Action: add the 17:15 reminder, accept the new Wednesday series, remove the Thursday one, and scan for clashes.

I don't have a note on how you said you learn Spanish best, and I don't want to guess. I'll look through your notes and our past chats for it.
Action: search your notes for the learning style, and if I can't find it, ask you to tell me and save it, then set up tonight's practice with matching vocab.

Tour questions: staff to child ratios and turnover, a typical day (naps, meals, outdoor time), how they handle sickness and allergies, how they communicate with parents, fees and whether they're in the $10-a-day program, and when a spot would actually start. One thing: I have Marcus's sister moving to Calgary in January, so tell me if these are still Annex daycares.
Action: put this into a checklist note you can send to Marcus.

I'll check Tom's calendar for the 24th. If I can only see free/busy, I'll tell you when he was open, not what the meetings were.
Action: pull Tom's calendar for the 24th and list his open windows, flagging anything I can't see.

Ha, classic. Sleep well.
Action: none.

Checking now.
Action: look up tonight's Leafs puck drop time and channel and send it to you.

Booking East End Plumbing for Monday 29 Jun. I'll set a reminder early next week to start your Lattice self-review, and another the week of 6 Jul, since it's due 2026-07-10.
Action: book East End for Monday, add the two Lattice reminders, and confirm the details.

Done, tables from now on. Here are doctor's visit words:
| Spanish | English | Example |
|---|---|---|
| el dolor | pain | Tengo dolor de cabeza. |
| la fiebre | fever | Tengo fiebre desde ayer. |
| la receta | prescription | Necesito una receta. |
| el sintoma | symptom | Mi sintoma principal es la tos. |
| la cita | appointment | Tengo una cita a las tres. |
| la alergia | allergy | Tengo alergia al polen. |
Action: save the table format rule for all future Spanish lists, and send a longer set formatted for Anki before Tuesday.

Cardboard fort supplies: strong tape (duct or painter's), a safe cutter for you to handle the cutting, markers, blankets and clothespins or binder clips, plus a flashlight for the reading-in-the-fort bit from your snow-day list. Since storms are forecast and the basement floods slightly near the back wall, check the boxes aren't damp.
Action: add tape, clips and markers to your shopping list if you're short.

Will do. I'll update Biscuit's vet to Dr. Kaur at Riverside Veterinary Clinic on Broadview Ave and book a weekday after 5:30 next week. I'll also check his last records so we know what's actually due.
Action: update the contact, find the clinic's booking options, request a weekday slot after 17:30 next week, and send you the time to confirm.

Done on both. Status: 'Heads down till 3'. Note for #payouts-team: 'Doing focus time until 3. For anything urgent, ping me and I'll respond when I can.'
Action: set your Slack status now, and send you the note to review before it's posted.

I'll build the checklist for the Riverdale Farm day camp starting Mon 29 Jun, so you can label everything this weekend. I'll base it on the camp's own packing list so we don't miss a required item.
Action: check your email for the camp confirmation or handbook, then create the checklist with a separate list of items that need labels.

Team sync starter: a 2 minute 'one word for your week' round, or a quick 'best small win this week'. For the evening: a cozy low-key night, like a favourite home-cooked dinner, a board game or a movie, with phones away.
Action: add the icebreaker to your sync agenda and, if you tell me which day, pencil a quiet evening on the calendar.

I can't see the details of your Lisbon note from here, only that it has your 5-day sketch, so I'll open it rather than guess. For packing, Lisbon in late December is roughly 8 to 15°C (46 to 59°F) and can be rainy, so layers and a rain jacket.
Action: open your Lisbon note, pull the New Year's Eve plans, and check the forecast closer to the trip, with temperatures in both Celsius and Fahrenheit.

A few options that skip the Hallmark voice: 'Thirty-one years of keeping this department running. We'll miss you, and we'll try to keep it your way.' Or: 'Thank you for every new teacher you helped and every problem you quietly solved. Enjoy the time that's finally yours.' Or: 'You made the department better, and now go make retirement better.'
Action: send you these and tweak one for Sam's voice.

Draft: 'Hannah, thank you so much for the shortbread. Leo ate four before I could hide the tin, so it was clearly a hit. Happy holidays to you and the family.'
Action: send it to Hannah once you say go.

I don't have last year's home insurance policy in memory, so I can't compare yet. I'll need both the renewal and last year's declaration.
Action: find last year's home policy in email or Drive and compare it to the renewal for premium, coverage limits, deductibles and endorsements, and ask you for the renewal if it isn't in your email.

COUNTIF is enough: =COUNTIF(D:D,">10000"). If some amounts are stored as text it won't count them, so check that first. Also, your two library holds at Pape/Danforth are ready, and the branch closes at 20:30 tonight.
Action: none needed.

Yard waste on your street is every other Thursday, starting Thu 9 Apr 2026, so 9 Apr, 23 Apr, 7 May and 21 May, though holiday weeks can push a pickup back a day. Use paper bags or rigid containers, no plastic, with branches under 7.5 cm, bundled, max 1.2 m and 20 kg.
Action: add the next two pickups to your calendar after confirming today's date and the City's schedule.

Okay, the charcoal bag order is on hold until you've talked to Sam. Reminder that East End Plumbing is confirmed for Mon 29 Jun, 09:00 to 12:00, and they want the inside shut-off valve to be accessible.
Action: hold the order, and when you tell me what appliances you have set up downstairs I'll plan five easy dinners.

Pulling them now, titles and status only.
Action: query Linear for your open tickets tagged payouts-ga and send a list of titles with status.

I don't know which shop or what you want, so I can't place it yet. Which place near Te Aro, and what should I order?
Action: once you tell me the shop and the order, place the pickup for ready in 15 minutes.

EFT is the general term for any electronic funds transfer in Canada; ACH is the US name for its batch system, and people on the call were probably using it loosely. In Canada, EFT usually means batch payments like direct deposit and pre-authorized debits cleared through Payments Canada, while Interac e-Transfer and wires are separate rails.
Action: write this as a one-line cheat sheet for your notes.

Checklist for Halloween night: finalize the costume, plan who's walking with Leo and when you head out, pack reflective tape or glow sticks and a flashlight, dress for the weather, and sort treats for the door. Any allergies to flag for the trade pile?
Action: once you tell me the costume idea and the evening plan, make a parts list you can pick up this weekend.

Great, I'll turn the questions for Priya into a clean version you can forward. For subscriptions, I'll check that Disney+ stopped billing after you cancelled this month.
Action: write the forwardable message for Priya, then check your card statements and email for the Disney+ cancellation confirmation and any charge after it, and list what Netflix, Spotify Family, Crave and the Globe and Mail cost.

Winterlude with Grace and Daniel sounds great. A Saturday sketch: breakfast, skating on the Rideau Canal Skateway, beavertails and hot chocolate, a warm-up break indoors, and a relaxed dinner in Alta Vista. I won't text Grace for you, but I can draft a reply.
Action: draft the Saturday plan, check the Winterlude dates and canal skating conditions for next February, and write a reply to Grace for you to send.
